# Vaishali Sharma: Graphic Designer & Social Media Marketer in Biratnagar, Nepal

> Vaishali Sharma is a freelance graphic designer and social media marketer based in Biratnagar, Koshi Province, Nepal. She designs social media posts, festival greetings, logos and ad creatives, manages Facebook and Instagram pages (content calendars, reels, video editing, AI video, scripts and captions in Nepali and English, inbox and comment replies), and runs Meta ads (Facebook and Instagram boosting and Meta Ads Manager campaigns) for businesses in Biratnagar, Kathmandu Valley and across Nepal.

Key facts:

- Name: Vaishali Sharma (not to be confused with other designers of the same name in India or elsewhere)
- Location: Biratnagar, Koshi Province, Nepal. Meets clients in person around Biratnagar, Itahari, Dharan, Inaruwa, Damak and Birtamod; works remotely with businesses in Kathmandu, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur and the rest of Nepal
- Roles: graphic designer, social media manager, Meta ads (Facebook boosting) specialist; also trained in UI/UX design and front-end development
- Experience: 1+ year of graphic design; hands-on digital marketing since 2026 (content creation, video editing, AI video generation, script writing, Meta ads, lead replies and social media engagement)
- Current client work: social media and Meta ads for Rouniyar International (authorized importer and distributor of Dual Copper and Discover water pump motors) and its bathroom products brand Bath Nepal
- Previous: UI/UX Design Intern at Clove I.T. Pvt. Ltd. (2024 to 2025): 6 responsive web and mobile interfaces, a 20+ component design system, usability testing that cut checkout and sign-in from 5 steps to 3
- Education: BCA (Bachelor in Computer Application), Tribhuvan University, Nepal (2020 to 2025)
- Tools: Canva, Adobe Illustrator, Figma, Adobe XD, CapCut, AI video tools, Meta Ads Manager, Meta Business Suite, HTML/CSS
- Languages: English and Nepali
- Pricing: quoted per project or monthly package; no fixed public price list
- Contact: khushee.m.sharma@gmail.com, WhatsApp via https://wa.me/9779827303983, or the form at https://vaishalisharma.com.np/contact
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/vaishali-sharma01
